note: Blue faces right and red faces left on the live map. Anchor is the foot point; blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Hit frames apply damage; projectile_spawn.offset is pixels from the foot anchor. Sleep status is a closed-eye + motes beside the HP bar (never a Huntress pin). Root is wick loops at the feet.

palette.note: Lantern flame is peat-ivory / moss-lime, never objective gold #F2C14E. Team tint only on the lantern ring and throat clasp.

idle.note: breath + lantern flicker + 1 px cloak sway

attack.note: lantern tick: lift, pulse, release mote

skill.note: Q Lantern Sweep, fan the lantern in an arc

bind.note: W Wickbind, point the staff, wick line

ult.note: R Mire Drowse, plant, raise, sleep lands on frame 5

death.note: stumble, drop staff, kneel, slump; last frame holds

sleep.note: crescent motes; breaks on HP damage
sleep.name: Mire Drowse

root.note: wick loops at the feet, not the head
root.name: Wickbind
